Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin compōnentem.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /kom.poˈnɛn.te/
  • Rhymes: -ɛnte
  • Hyphenation: com‧po‧nèn‧te

Participle

[edit]

componente m or f by sense (plural componenti)

  1. present participle of comporre

Noun

[edit]

componente m (plural componenti)

  1. component

Noun

[edit]

componente f (plural componenti)

  1. (figurative) element

Adjective

[edit]

componente m or f by sense (plural componenti)

  1. component

Portuguese

[edit]
Portuguese Wikipedia has an article on:
componente
Wikipedia pt

Etymology

[edit]

Learned borrowing from Latin compōnentem. By surface analysis, compor +‎ -ente.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /kõ.poˈnẽ.t͡ʃi/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /kõ.poˈnẽ.t͡ʃi/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /kõ.poˈnẽ.te/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /kõ.puˈnẽ.tɨ/

  • Rhymes: (Brazil) -ẽti, -ẽt͡ʃi, (Portugal) -ẽtɨ
  • Hyphenation: com‧po‧nen‧te

Noun

[edit]

componente (Brazil) m (Portugal) m or f (plural componentes)

  1. component (smaller, self-contained part of larger entity)

Quotations

[edit]
  • For quotations using this term, see Citations:componente.

Related terms

[edit]
  • componível
  • compor
  • composição
  • composto

Further reading

[edit]
  • “componente”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “componente”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Romanian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [kompoˈnente]

Noun

[edit]

componente n

  1. indefinite plural of component

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin compōnentem.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /kompoˈnente/ [kõm.poˈnẽn̪.t̪e]
  • Rhymes: -ente
  • Syllabification: com‧po‧nen‧te

Noun

[edit]

componente m (plural componentes)

  1. component

Noun

[edit]

componente m or f by sense (plural componentes)

  1. member
    Synonym: miembro

Adjective

[edit]

componente m or f (masculine and feminine plural componentes)

  1. component

Related terms

[edit]
  • componer

Further reading

[edit]
  • “componente”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025
